name: Raunaq Verma
short: Having been to Jim Corbett a couple of times before, I'd never had an experience similar to this one. The drive was perfect and the stay inside the core zone of the forest was the highlight.
full: I recently visited Jim Corbett on a trip organised by Tarang and Asili. Having been to Jim Corbett a couple of times before, I never had an experience similar to this one. The drive was perfect, the stay inside the forest was amazing, and the highlight remained the sightings and the photographs we captured. He knew the right spots to take us around and make this experience a memorable one. I would highly recommend booking and having an experience with them and I'm already looking forward to my next one.
